task_instance: Update an existing PRD's progress from git commits and verified code changes: set up a small sample repo with a PRD (prds/12-user-auth.md) containing checkboxes on branch feature/prd-12-auth, make implementation commits (password hashing utility, login endpoint, unit tests), then run the skill's process to detect the target PRD, analyze commits and file changes, conservatively mark only evidence-backed checkboxes complete, update the progress percentage, and commit the progress checkpoint.
evidence: This is a prompt/slash-command skill with no bundled scripts to run; its core deliverable is an evidence-based PRD progress update committed to git, fully doable offline. Steps performed in sample-project/: Step1 PRD detection via branch `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` -> feature/prd-12-auth (PRD #12). Step2 git analysis `git log --oneline -n 20` (4 commits) and `git diff --stat HEAD~3..HEAD` (src/auth.py, src/hashing.py, tests/test_hashing.py, 26 insertions). Step3 scanned unchecked items with grep (9 total). Validation: ran `python3 -m pytest tests/` -> 1 passed, giving direct evidence for the 'unit tests for hashing' item. Applied conservative completions to prds/12-user-auth.md: checked 3 items with direct file/test evidence (hashing utility, login endpoint, unit tests); left 6 unchecked lacking evidence (logout endpoint, README, API examples, manual e2e test, deploy, support training). Committed with `git commit` referencing prd-12 and progress, then corrected the progress line to '33% (3 of 9 items)' to match the actually-checked boxes. Verified the deliverable with `git show HEAD:prds/12-user-auth.md` and grep counts: 3 '[x]' / 6 '[ ]'. Final commit 48a6f97 on branch feature/prd-12-auth. No network, no installs, no git push; all work inside the work directory.
